name: Erika Hakurei
source:
Erika is a caring soul who wants to help others, but void of boundaries she's often kept at arm’s length. Growing up in an orphanage and enamoured with the beautiful people she'd see on television, Erika dedicated herself to making her dull, ugly world into an equally perfect one. Empathy and steady hands made Erika a great help to the nurses whenever other children were hurt, and over time she developed the surgical prowess to bring those glitzy ideals to life; patients willing or not.
